title: JJA Official Pack
description: The official modpack configured so you can play Jujutsu Addon and JujutsuCraft right away.
body:
# JJA Official Modpack

JJA Official Modpack is the official Forge 1.20.1 modpack for playing Jujutsu Addon with JujutsuCraft.

It includes Jujutsu Addon, JujutsuCraft, required libraries, compatibility mods, performance fixes, and curated configuration files for a ready-to-play client and dedicated server setup.

## Features

* Official modpack for Jujutsu Addon.
* Built for Minecraft 1.20.1 and Forge 47.4.10.
* Includes JujutsuCraft and the required JJA dependency stack.
* Adds performance and stability mods such as ModernFix, FerriteCore, MemoryLeakFix, Packet Fixer, and ServerCore.
* Includes gameplay/configuration support for In Control, Lootr, Curios, Pehkui, Geckolib, and related libraries.
* Provides matching client and server artifacts for multiplayer setup.

Use the matching server pack when hosting a dedicated server.
